# Wave 5, Part A4a: body-text queries for L1 Q5, Q10, Q13

Run 2026-11-10. Headless curl, desktop user agent, no email. Every raw response is under `raw/` with URL, date, and HTTP status (HTML comment header for arXiv pages; `.url` or `.meta` sidecars elsewhere). Script: `raw/axft_search.py` (reads up to 10 pages of 10 hits, so at most 100 results per query); snippet filter: `raw/screen_filter.py` (flags hits whose returned snippet mentions both a code benchmark or code-generation term and a calibration or confidence term). Every hit was screened by title and returned body snippet; flagged hits and any hit naming a cell concept were opened in full text (see CELLS.md).

## Instruments

| Instrument | Status today | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| arXiv full-text search, `https://search.arxiv.org/?in=&query=` | PASS (30 queries, 172 page requests, all HTTP 200) | Returns body-text snippets (for example table captions and appendix text), so it is a body-text instrument. Pagination by `&startat=10..90`. Query box maxlength 64; all queries are shorter. |
| OpenAlex `filter=fulltext.search:` and `search=` | HTTP 200 on 10 of 10 | First 50 results screened per query (per-page=50). Full-text coverage partial (W4 G-OA), so negatives remain weak. |
| OpenReview `api2.openreview.net/notes/search?term=` | HTTP 200 on 9 of 9 | 100 notes per query screened by title and abstract. |
| Semantic Scholar `/graph/v1/paper/search` | 2 of 3 queries FAIL (HTTP 429 on all 6 attempts, backoff 0, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 s); S13-1 HTTP 200 on attempt 4 | Gap G-S2 persists for Q5 and Q10. |
| Crossref, DataCite | HTTP 200 | Used for the W4 leads 10.1109/tse.2026.3713834 and the Tuerlings dataset record. |
| arXiv PDF fetch plus local text extraction | HTTP 200 on 11 of 11 | `raw/ft/<id>.pdf`, `.txt`, `.meta`. |

## Primary: arXiv full-text search

Total for the primary instrument: 30 queries (10 per cell), 172 page requests (all HTTP 200), 1,643 hits read (A10-09 reports 59 hits but returned 60 rows across pages; both recorded).
